title: Tantrasāra, Ahnika 1 — Essence of the Tantrāloka
author: Abhinavagupta
text:
The Tantrasāra is Abhinavagupta's own condensation of his encyclopedic Tantrāloka — the great survey of Śaiva practice and doctrine — prepared so that the essence (sāra) of the system could be recited and performed in daily portions. Our text carries its opening ahnikas. The first begins in invocation: the mother of the stainless art and of new creation, and the five-faced father, are called forth before the teaching starts.

Its juice: the Tantrasāra's method is reduction without dilution — hundreds of Tantrāloka pages compressed into what a practitioner can actually keep. Its juice is that Abhinavagupta, having built the largest edifice in the tradition, then distilled it: what remains in these pages is the living core, arranged for use rather than for library.
